headlines.headline: Lakers' reported $12 billion sale headlines NBA preseason as LeBron debuts with Sixers
headlines.detail: The reported $12B sale is a North American sports franchise record. LeBron James opened his 24th season with his fourth franchise in Philadelphia alongside Jaylen Brown, Joel Embiid, and Tyrese Maxey as the league's 67-game preseason slate continues.

headlines.headline: Falcons' James Pearce Jr. suspended 8 games for conduct policy violation
headlines.detail: Atlanta's edge rusher loses eight games without pay, a significant blow to the pass rush. The news comes alongside the NFL's midseason Top 100 rankings, where Seahawks QB Sam Darnold jumped 51 spots to No. 21.

headlines.headline: Ohio State's Jeremiah Smith sets program records as Alabama, Missouri deliver the weekend's biggest road wins
headlines.detail: Smith caught 11 passes for 206 yards and 2 TDs in a 31-14 win over Iowa. No. 7 Alabama routed Mississippi State 56-23 and No. 25 Missouri upset No. 8 Florida 45-17.

headlines.headline: St. John's guard Donnie Freeman out for the season after Achilles surgery
headlines.detail: Coach Rick Pitino confirmed the non-contact injury will sideline the rising junior guard for all of 2026-27, a major blow to St. John's depth ahead of Big East play.
